requirements.text: 3-6 years in project management or business analysis in a structured organization
At least two cross-functional IT implementation, digitalization or automation projects taken from idea to adoption
Solid process analysis and modeling skills in a standard notation (BPMN, EPC or similar)
Experience writing business requirements that developers or vendors can build from
A formal PM approach (PMBOK, PRINCE2, IPMA or similar) that you actually apply
Everyday use of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) in your own work
Up-to-date trade registration to verify your company
PMP, PRINCE2, IPMA, CBAP or IREB certification
Basic SQL; experience with Fibery, Jira, Confluence or similar
Experience with vendor or SaaS selection and implementation

resumes.text:
Miriam Kovac
Business Analyst and Project Manager, freelance, Berlin

Summary
Six years of business analysis and project management in structured organisations. I turn operational problems into mapped processes, clear requirements and systems that people actually use. My trade registration for freelance work is current, and I am available for assignments of three to six months.

Experience
Freelance Business Analyst and Project Manager, Berlin (2021 to present)
- Deliver process and IT change for mid-sized lenders and insurers, typically on projects of three to five months.
- Led the onboarding workflow redesign for a digital lending platform: as-is mapping with the credit team, a requirement pack for the in-house development team, and rollout to four branches. Measured adoption reached 90 percent of new cases within two months, measured against the old baseline.
- Took an automated claims triage project for a regional insurer from the first workshop to measured adoption, including training sessions and a feedback loop that changed the routing rules twice.
- Wrote user stories, acceptance criteria and edge-case tables that the development teams built from without rework.
- Ran stage-gate governance with defined initiation, design, build and adoption gates, sign-off criteria and tolerance thresholds, plus a charter, RACI matrix, risk log and monthly status reports to the steering group.
- Generative assistants are part of my daily work: I use them to draft requirement packs and summarise interview transcripts.

Business Analyst, Halden Mobility GmbH, Hamburg (2020 to 2021)
- Modelled fleet booking processes with process owners across operations and finance.
- Specified a telematics data feed and reviewed the developer's test results against the acceptance criteria.

Education
BSc Business Informatics, Lakeshore University of Applied Sciences, 2016 to 2019

Certifications
PMI-ACP (Agile Practitioner), 2022

Skills
Process modelling in BPMN 2.0 and EPC, Signavio, Visio, SQL (SELECT queries, joins and reporting), Jira, Confluence, Notion, stakeholder workshops, risk and issue management.

Languages
English (C1, certified), German (native), Russian (fluent)

Tomasz Weber
Project Coordinator, Cologne

Summary
Four years of project coordination and business analysis in an insurance back office. Experienced with in-house process digitisation and process documentation. I am now looking for a freelance assignment.

Experience
Project Coordinator, Rheinfeld Versicherung AG, Cologne (2022 to 2026)
- Coordinated one in-house claims intake digitisation for the claims department, from idea through go-live. Adoption was then owned by the operations team, so I did not track usage metrics after handover.
- Kept a weekly status report and a risk list for the project, and facilitated the steering meetings.
- Mapped claims handling in BPMN 1.1 notation in Visio for the department handbook. I have not worked in a BPMN 2.0 modelling tool.
- Wrote specification documents that the internal IT team built against without rework, and reviewed their test cases against the acceptance criteria.
- Used Jira daily for tickets and Confluence for process pages.

Customer Service Team Lead, Lindner Logistik, Bonn (2020 to 2022)
- Reduced the complaint backlog by 40 percent by rewriting the escalation procedure.
- Trained twelve staff on the new ticketing system.

Education
BA Business Administration, Fachhochschule Weststadt, 2016 to 2019

Skills
Process mapping (Visio, flowcharts), SQL reporting basics (SELECT queries and simple joins), Jira, Confluence, Excel, insurance claims handling, stakeholder communication.

Languages
German (native), Russian (fluent, family language), English (C1, Cambridge CAE)

Trade registration
Trade registration (Gewerbeanmeldung) filed for freelance coordination work in 2026.

Anja Schroder
Operations Manager, Leipzig

Summary
Eight years of restaurant and bakery operations management. I run teams, rotas, stock and suppliers, and I care about a calm, well-trained shop floor. Strong customer focus and a steady hand during busy weekends.

Experience
Operations Manager, Lindenhof Bakery Group, Leipzig (2021 to 2026)
- Managed daily operations for five bakery branches and a team of 60 staff across early and late shifts.
- Negotiated flour and packaging contracts with three local suppliers and renewed them on better terms.
- Rewrote the opening and closing checklists for all branches so every shift follows one standard routine.
- Run monthly stock counts and manage the waste report, which cut spoilage by 12 percent.
- Use an assistant chatbot to draft the weekly staff newsletter; it saves me about two hours a week.

Shift Supervisor, Cafe Sonnenweg, Dresden (2018 to 2021)
- Ran morning shifts, trained new hires and handled customer complaints at the counter.
- Balanced the daily cash reconciliation and kept the food safety log up to date.

Education
Certificate in Retail Management, Dresden Vocational College, 2018
Food hygiene certificate (HACCP), renewed 2025

Skills
Rota planning, stock control, supplier negotiation, POS systems, staff training, food safety, customer service.

German (native), English (C1, from evening courses and international guests)
